        <box size="0.476 0.018 0.232"/>

        <color rgba="0.30 0.30 0.30 1"/>
      </material>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.03 0.12" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.476 0.420 0.232"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <collision>

      <geometry>
